items.title: Using Digital Tools to Create a Business Plan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of digital tools for business plans (PDF 211).

blocks.text: Digital auzaar business plan banana aasan aur kaarkard banate aur use mukammal aur peshawarana banane mein madad dete hain. Do qismein sab se zyada madadgar hain: plan likhne ka software aur team ke liye mil kar kaam karne ke auzaar.

blocks.prompt: Business plans ke liye digital auzaar ki do qismein bataiye.

items: Digital auzaar: plan likhne ka software aur collaboration tools.
